movie.title: The Runner
movie.overview: A high-powered attorney must race through London, following the cryptic commands of a mysterious caller, as she fights against time to save her abducted son.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When her young son is kidnapped, high-powered London attorney Maia Marten must navigate a frantic race across the city while executing a series of cryptic, escalating commands from an unseen caller.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In this high-stakes action thriller, successful London attorney Maia Marten finds her world shattered when her young son is abducted. Forced to comply with the demands of an anonymous caller, Maia is plunged into a relentless urban chase across London. With every directive threatening to push her past her moral limits, she must outsmart a mysterious puppet master before time runs out to save her child.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Maia Marten is a formidable, high-powered attorney living in London who appears to have total control over her personal and professional life. Everything shatters when her young son is suddenly kidnapped by a cold, calculating strategist known only as 'The Caller.' Instead of demanding a standard ransom, the abductor forces Maia into a dangerous, high-speed ordeal across the metropolis, giving her precise, cryptic instructions that she must fulfill down to the second. As Maia sprints through the streets, subway stations, and landmarks of London, each task becomes increasingly dangerous and ethically compromised, testing how far she will go to protect her family. With local law enforcement struggling to track the shadowy perpetrator, Maia is forced to rely on her quick legal mind and raw survival instincts. As secrets from her past legal cases begin to resurface, she realizes the kidnapping is linked to a larger conspiracy. Racing against a ticking clock, Maia must untangle the caller's true motives and turn the tables on her tormentor to rescue her son.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Runner is an intense, real-time-style thriller following Maia Marten, a top-tier attorney operating in London. After her young son is abducted by an elusive antagonist known as The Caller, Maia receives a deadly ultimatum: follow every command issued through her phone without alerting the authorities, or her son will pay with his life. Forced into a grueling physical and psychological race across London, Maia must navigate a series of clandestine tasks, unpredictable obstacles, and moral dilemmas designed to break her down. Along the way, she discovers that her tormentor's game is deeply tied to her past courtroom triumphs and high-profile legal battles. Tension builds as Maia utilizes her intellect, resilience, and resourcefulness to uncover the caller's identity while fighting against time to secure her son's safety.

story_structure.climax: A frantic final confrontation brings her face-to-face with the perpetrator, forcing her to make a desperate choice to rescue her son before time runs out.
story_structure.conflict: Her son is suddenly abducted, and a mysterious caller demands total obedience to a series of cryptic, time-sensitive instructions.
story_structure.resolution: The ordeal comes to a tense conclusion as mother and son are reunited, leaving her to process the dramatic fallout of the day's events.
story_structure.introduction: A high-powered attorney lives a demanding, fast-paced life in London, unaware of the crisis about to shatter her routine.
story_structure.risingAction: She races across London under immense pressure, completing increasingly dangerous and compromising tasks while desperately searching for clues about the caller's identity.
